cP.role: candidate cold: the rank-probe producer's cold path, which is the rank-cut producer's code (KIC_RANK_SOLVE is read only by the rank stage, which a cold process skips); its own processes, so the candidate's end-to-end cost is measured on its own rows

cPI.role: pre-registered secondary (optional component, never decides): cP with lift_scan canonicalizing the index build (KIC_INDEX_CANON=lift; the rank-cut run's cRI, 1.3377x cold without rank, about 3% end to end)

cR.role: baseline cold: the rank-cut producer's cold path (koblitz-n83-rankcut-20261016 arm cR, the n=83 baseline once PR #970 lands), setup + one-target online with the verified cached factor-log table

kP.role: candidate rank stage: kR's loop in the target's Frobenius frame (KIC_RANK_SOLVE=frame): x(T +- phi^s(R_k)) = phi^s(x(T_s +- R_k)) with T_s = phi^(-s)(T) tabulated once per attempt, so the two per-candidate normal-to-polynomial maps of the conjugate root are gone; the same partner words, keys and probes; then one target

kPX.role: planted positive control: kP plus the work it removes, redone: the rank-cut loop's whole key derivation (per-candidate maps, its own batched inversion and partner formulas, canonical keys) on every candidate of every state, compared with kP's keys field by field (panic on any difference) and discarded

kPaa.role: A/A control: a second process of kP

kR.role: baseline rank stage: the rank-cut producer's (lift_scan, Feistel, the 16-byte compact table over the folded index, partner roots by point addition, KIC_RANK_SOLVE=padd), then one target

rT.role: A's tuned rho rT770 (Fold/64/DP6), the strongest one-target rho at n=83, same points

controls_pass_rule.aa: E2E(kP, cP) / E2E(kPaa, cR) (blocks paired) and cold cP / cR (the same cold code) point estimates both inside [0.97, 1.03]
controls_pass_rule.planted: rank stage kPX / kP (per-attempt cost, attempts paired within blocks), 95% bootstrap lower bound above 1

exactness_argument: E is defined over F_2, so the Frobenius phi(x, y) = (x^2, y^2) is a group automorphism of E(F_2^83) and T +- phi^s(R) = phi^s(phi^(-s)(T) +- R). The rank-cut loop computes, for every shift s and stored root R_k (its y recovered by the half-trace), the partners x(T +- R_{k,s}) with R_{k,s} = phi^s(R_k) by one point addition from the polynomial-basis (x, y) of R_{k,s}. The frame loop computes x(T_s +- R_k) with T_s = phi^(-s)(T) by the same addition formulas (lambda = (y(T_s) + y(R_k)) / D, lambda' = lambda + x(R_k) / D, D = x(T_s) + x(R_k), x = lambda^2 + lambda + x(T_s) + x(R_k) + a) and applies phi^s, a rotation of the normal-basis word. The two are the same field elements, so the emitted normal-basis partner words are equal bit for bit, in the same order (minus, plus, with the same recovered y), hence the same canonical keys, partner shifts, candidate indices and probe positions. The exceptional inputs coincide (x(R_{k,s}) = x(T) iff x(R_k) = x(T_s); x(R_{k,s}) = 0 iff x(R_k) = 0; x(T) = 0 iff x(T_s) = 0) and are solved by the S3 solver on the rank-cut loop's S3 input, formed on demand; a root failing the curve check falls back to the compact loop exactly as in the rank-cut loop; at every root-table hit the rank-cut loop's exact S3-order resolution runs unchanged on the same S3 input. So the first hit, the lift, the relation and the probe count of every attempt are the rank-cut loop's (hence the S3 loop's); the echelon and the factor-log table are B's. Tested on a 9-orbit base (every loop, both orders, the swapped emission order; the frame keys against the rank-cut keys; the Frobenius identity) and checked key by key on every candidate of every kPX rank stage.
gates: every scheduled row valid (exit 0, verified, schedule match, no memory event)

every IC process: lift_scan, Feistel, prefetch; the 16-byte compact table with 2^26 slots over the folded index (14,940,300 stored of 29,880,000 logical states); 29,878,182 table entries; logical-state blake3 and table-map digests equal B's (online.index_digest); no root bloom
per point: one scalar across every IC process (cold and rank) and rT, replayed as [d]G = Q in the pinned oracle
per point: one relation (point indices) and one probe count across every IC process on the point
Q0 (O1): cR and cP give the archived Feistel relation and scalar with 1,987,852 probes
rank arms: full rank, the arm's KIC_RANK_SOLVE recorded, and the written factor-log table equal to B's archived table, log for log

per rank block: rank_relations_blake3, the per-attempt probe vector (600 entries), rank_root_calls_total and the point-addition counters (rank_padd_fallback_states, rank_padd_irregular_inputs, rank_padd_resolved_hits, rank_padd_swapped_pairs) identical across kR, kP, kPaa and kPX (the candidate keeps every relation, every probe and every pair order of the baseline, not only the table)

frame counters: kR builds no frame and checks nothing; kP, kPaa and kPX build exactly one frame per rank attempt; kPX has rank_frame_plant_checked_inputs > 0 (every candidate of its rank stage compared with the rank-cut keys) and kP / kPaa have 0; rank_padd_plant_checked_inputs is 0 everywhere
multiplicity: one primary statistic; every secondary (cPI included) is descriptive and never changes the verdict

online.cold_interval: producer's own clock: process start (main) .. recovery_check_end of the one target = setup_complete + the five online phases (cold_in_process_ms); in ic_cold the rank stage is skipped (verified cached table); the index digest runs after the target, outside every interval
